pageProps.title: The Wild Robot (2024)
pageProps.review: A review of the animated film 'The Wild Robot,' which tells a warm and touching story of a robot created by human greed becoming the guardian of a baby goose, conveying the true meaning of bonding and sacrifice.
pageProps.content:
## Review The story of a robot that becomes the guardian of a baby goose. It had a solid story and the kind of emotion you'd expect from a great animation.
Can a robot created by human greed truly be free of greed?
